decision.explanation: The question asks for the birth date of 'Empress Borjigit'. The source documents identify three distinct individuals of the Borjigit clan who held the title of Empress: Empress Xiaozhuangwen (born 28 March 1613, D1S1), Empress Xiaoduanwen (born 31 May 1599, D2S1/D2S3), and Empress Xiaohuizhang (born 5 November 1641, D3S5). Since the query uses the clan name 'Borjigit' rather than a specific personal name or posthumous title, all three valid birth dates for empresses of this clan must be included as distinct valid answers. The candidate '5 November 1641' from D3S5 ('Empress Xiaohuizhang (5 November 1641...') is retained as it refers to another Empress of the Borjigit clan.
